name: Colophon
consensus_rounds: review, challenge and appeal each bind verdict and evidence_supports_claim
lifecycle_rules: the licence fee is enforced to the wei against the work's registered fee
a report bonds that same fee, and an owner cannot report their own work
each round opens a window in which only the side it went against may act
settlement is refused inside the window unless the caller is that side
requests and reports both run REVIEW, CHALLENGE and APPEAL
UNCLEAR is neutral on both paths: value returns and standing does not move
payable methods never raise once value is attached, they refund and record
only the side the current verdict went against may challenge, appeal, or finalise inside the window, and all four read the holder from the same helper the view get_settlement_window reports

superseded_deployments.reason: either party could open a challenge or an appeal, including the one the current verdict favoured
